races.verdict: KILLEEMORE LAD has made a promising start over fences and could prove hard to catch around here if he's again ridden prominently. Tell Us This won a big-field Galway handicap chase a fortnight ago but his jumping remains a concern, while the quirky Luker's Tipple wouldn't be the safest conveyance despite going for a hat-trick on his chasing debut. KILLEEMORE LAD (IRE) TELL US THIS (IRE) LUKER'S TIPPLE (IRE)

races.verdict: JUKE HILL went with promise on his chase debut at Wexford and can score with the longer trip likely to suit. races.verdict: DREAM ON BABY is yet to finish outside the placings in her 4 Flat starts and partnered by a jockey who has enjoyed plenty of success in this race in recent seasons, Emmet Mullins' 6-y-o earns the vote. Splashing Out has been in good heart over hurdles this summer so she looks an interesting runner switched to this sphere, with Kimy and Blue Nasturtium another couple worth considering, too.
